note: THE FATHOM MERGED (883c63ae) — closing the loop on notice a720436e, and one finding worth more than the feature. What landed: GeneratedClimate::strata_at and biome_expr_at_stratum, the column the BiomeExpr type always carried and the single accessor discarded. Byte-identical worlds, proven by an empty drift check on the merged tree. THE COLLISION THAT NOTICE WARNED ABOUT DID NOT HAPPEN, but a worse one nearly did: windows/locale ALREADY HAD both accessors — water_column_at and expr_at_stratum, same derivation, same doc-comment argument — shipped before the campaign opened. The campaign built a duplicate and only found it because a later task read the neighbouring window on a hunch. The task review could not have caught it: the duplicate lived in a file no diff touched. GENERALISATION FOR ANYONE DERIVING FROM A SHARED TYPE: grep the CONSUMERS of that type, not just its producer. Does this exist in this crate and does this exist are different questions. Resolved by delegation, not deletion — locale now calls climate, and its two divergent contracts (empty vec on land, open water below the floor) are preserved byte-for-byte and documented as known-wrong. TWO THINGS LEFT STANDING DELIBERATELY, both recorded in docs/retrospectives/the-fathom.md: expr_at_stratum answers open water for a rung of solid rock below the floor, and classify_marine_expr files 92 percent of sea ice below the epipelagic (8916 of 9695 cells). Neither repaired, because repairing either moves world bytes.
